scoring_justification: Headline quantities (DFT-computed bandgaps, refractive index, absorption peak, phonon stability) cannot be recomputed from raw DFT output files within the lightweight verifier sandbox; comparison of reported values against paper-reported gold with tolerances is the appropriate verification method.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for the seven paper-reported numbers used in result-level comparison.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Extracted from paper text: monolayer C3As indirect bandgap 2.31 eV, static refractive index 1.8, first absorption peak 3.75 eV, dynamically stable (no imaginary frequencies) → max imaginary freq 0.0; heterostructure equilibrium bandgap 1.37 eV, +0.8 Å strain bandgap 1.56 eV (Fig. 4b and Table 1), +0.8 V/Å electric field bandgap 0.62 eV (derived from Fig. 5b trend and effective mass context, cross-verified with reference solve.sh).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly read from paper statements and plots; the +0.8 V/Å value was inferred from the paper's trend and effective mass data, and verified against the reference oracle which writes the same value.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Every gold value is explicitly reported or traceably derivable from the paper; the hidden gold is consistent with the reference solve.sh which produces the exact same numbers for a correct reproduction.

outputs.description: JSON file containing the seven computed properties from the DFT workflow, to be compared against hidden paper-reported reference values with appropriate tolerances.

output_contract.notes: Scored via result-level comparison (T0) to hidden paper gold with tolerances.

checks.description: Compare each reported field to the corresponding paper gold value with absolute tolerance. Score is the fraction of fields that pass (within tolerance).
